notes: Limited: a 40-case cluster described in an outbreak investigation, with side-by-side group comparisons and no computed ratio, test or CI. view_issues: Text says 10 of the 11 persons living with HIV received 2 doses of JYNNEOS or 1 dose of ACAM2000, but Table 1 shows 5 in that group. Text gives a median of 1.5 sex partners for the other group, but Table 1 gives 1 (0-6).
